row.team_price_text: Corpay One card program: $0 per account per month with 10+ active cards, $59 with 9 or fewer; other Corpay products Contact Sales
row.evidence: No Corpay page mentions SCIM or SSO: the Corpay One help centre returns no articles for SSO, SCIM or Okta, and the Corpay One pricing link opens a card-program fee schedule ($59 per account per month for 9 or fewer active cards).
row.notes: Corpay (formerly FLEETCOR) sells corporate payments: AP automation, commercial cards, cross-border FX and the SMB Corpay One app. Only Corpay One has public pricing (its /pricing/ link redirects to the Fuel & Business Expense Mastercard client agreement: $0 per account per month with 10+ active cards, $59 with 9 or fewer) and a public help centre; users there are added and deactivated manually in Settings > Users, and advisor accounts can import staff by CSV. The enterprise products (Corpay Complete AP automation, Cross-Border) publish no pricing or admin docs, so SCIM/SSO cannot be ruled out: status stays unknown. No Okta OIN app (corpay, corpay-one, corpay-complete, corpay-cross-border slugs 404) and no Entra tutorial found.

plans.name: Corpay One (Fuel & Business Expense Mastercard)
plans.price_text: $0 per account per month for 10 or more active cards; $59 per account per month for 9 or fewer active cards
plans.notes: Per-account card-program membership fee, not per user. Other Corpay products are quote-only.

user_api.notes: Corpay markets a Cross-Border payments API and a card API for partners; no user-management API is documented publicly.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial at corpay-tutorial, corpay-provisioning-tutorial, corpay-one-tutorial, fleetcor-tutorial or corpay-cross-border-tutorial.

fallbacks.notes: CSV import is documented for staff on Corpay One advisor accounts; regular users are added and deactivated manually under Settings > Users.
